_meta.notes: Golden cases for narrator confidence regression. Outcomes verified against the live Toronto AIC ArcGIS FeatureServer on the date above. Every real case's description also exists in data/enriched/dev_applications.parquet, so integration-time TF-IDF similarity returns the case itself as a ~100% comparable: for approved cases this deterministically triggers the precedent floor-55; for refused cases (dev_approved=0) it does not. ci.site blocks are snapshots of lookup_site_context() output so the CI tier needs no data/reference or duckdb. Run `just narrator-eval` for per-case detail. Band derivation: floors/caps are deterministic one-sided anchors; the ceiling of 88 for non-capped cases is the system prompt's Step-2A maximum (base band max 80 + max within-band adjustment of +8). Cap-30 cases use a lower bound of 10, the floor of the prompt's extreme-violation band. Bands calibrated against ~6 live runs on 2026-06-12; observed ranges are recorded per case in notes. 2026-06-12 refused/revised triage batch (yonge-374, dupont-328, mendota-2, finch-57-revised, finch-57-original): cases selected from scripts/narrator_refused_triage.py over all unique refused applications; refusal reasons researched in specs/2026-06-12-narrator-refusal-gap-analysis.md. NOTE: the AIC layer schema changed by 2026-06 — the GET verification URLs recorded for the original 8 cases now return 400; use POST with where=FOLDERRSN IN (...) and the STATUS_DESC field instead. 2026-06-12 scoring change (gap-analysis proposals 1-3: floor-70 demotion to 55 on unverified limits, storeys-to-metres inference at 3m/storey, FSI checking): wellesley-68, yonge-374, dupont-328 re-banded from advisory [70,88] to assertable [10,30]; finch pair re-banded to floor-55 bands.

cases.label: 1613 St Clair Ave W — 17st/258u mixed-use OZ, Council-approved 2022
cases.description: The developer intends to develop the subject lands with a 17-storey, 57 meter mixed-use building consisting of 258 units in 16,732 square meters of residential floor area and 1,404 square meters of non-residential floor area. Non-residential floor area would be comprised of 57square metres of community space, 271 square metres of retail, and 1,076 square metres of medical office. A total of 575.4 square meters of indoor amenity area and 721 square meters of outdoor amenity area is proposed. A Site Plan Control application has also been submitted in support of the proposal and has been circulated concurrently. The proposal has been revised to provide medical office space and community space noted above, simplified floor plates, relocation of parking to provide nine vehicle parking spaces above grade and 92 parking spaces below grade.
cases.notes: 57m proposed vs 11m zone limit (5.2x) would trigger the cap-30, but the same-zone Council-approved comparable at 100% similarity within 250m exempts it and floors confidence at 55. The height violation is structural, so the floor-70 does not apply. In integration runs the TF-IDF self-match against the enriched parquet provides the precedent. Observed over 6 calibration runs (2026-06-12): 55-78 (55 = precedent floor binding).
